words.gloss_range: forceful deterrent and discourse arrest, not simple negation
words.prose: {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}) opens the ayah by stopping the prior posture before any content word appears. It is not a neutral no: it rejects the preoccupation that has just run to the graves and then launches the future warning. Because there is no connective at the ayah boundary, the shift from the prior limit to this first particle is abrupt; the visible graveyard scene gives way to an unlocated arrest. The same opening returns in the exact warning refrain at 102:4, so this first word is also the start of a repeated pressure. Even its compact sound, with the doubled middle consonant before the long release, lets the opening deterrence be heard as a held stop before the sentence moves forward.

topics.headline: deterrence rejects and launches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word both rejects the previous posture and hands the addressees into the coming knowledge-warning.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}) as a deterrent particle before the verbal assertion, while the broader note about possible affirmative readings is only a comparison and does not replace the local deterrent force.

topics.headline: first-position particle breaks the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah boundary as rupture: the prior motion reaches its limit, then the new ayah begins with arrest rather than continuation.
topics.reason: The word stands first in the ayah, with no coordinating particle between 102:2 and 102:3, and the attachment evidence treats the following words as the verbal assertion introduced by this opening.

topics.headline: deterrent opens a repeated warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the interruption is not isolated, because the same opening warning phrase returns at 102:4.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row gives the concrete same-surah recurrence at 102:4, and nothing in the reference evidence contradicts that refrain relation.

topics.headline: sound shape enacts arrest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening deterrence as a compact held stop before the sentence releases into the warning.
topics.reason: The local surface supports the described doubled middle consonant and long final vowel, so the phonetic payoff can remain as a candidate observation.

words.gloss_range: independent future particle with extended, emphatic warning force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening deterrent particle before the future marker

words.prose: {{ar:سَوْفَ}} ({{tr:sawfa}}) gives futurity its own word between the rejection and the verb rather than folding it onto the verb as a bound prefix. Its scope reaches {{ar:تَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿlamūna}}), so the coming act of knowing is made certain while its content remains unstated. The separate particle also creates a timed corridor: {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}) arrests, {{ar:سَوْفَ}} ({{tr:sawfa}}) delays and projects, and the verb then names the coming cognition. Across the boundary, the prior completed visit and the closing limit at the graves yield to a future horizon. The same particle returns in the exact warning phrase at 102:4, making futurity itself part of the refrain, and its lighter sibilant-fricative shape lets the warning lengthen after the hard opening stop.

topics.headline: futurity becomes threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is certain but not immediate or specified; the future particle leaves both timing and known content open.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support extended future scope over {{ar:تَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿlamūna}}); the broader afterlife horizon in the CRITICAL note is kept as warning pressure, not as a locally specified time claim.

topics.headline: separate word creates a temporal hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that futurity is not just a prefix on the verb; it occupies the middle beat that turns rejection into delayed warning.
topics.reason: The local surface uses an independent future particle before the imperfect verb, and attachment evidence marks that particle as the head governing the verbal complement.

topics.headline: future marker is repeated at 102:4
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the delayed future is doubled in the next ayah rather than resolved after the first warning.
topics.reason: The same future particle appears inside the repeated warning phrase at 102:4, so the row's forward-looking refrain claim is locally concrete.

topics.headline: completed visit gives way to projected knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the time-direction reverse at the boundary: the prior action has reached its limit, while knowledge is still projected ahead.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows compare the prior completed boundary with the future particle in 102:3, and the local syntax confirms that {{ar:سَوْفَ}} ({{tr:sawfa}}) introduces the future verbal assertion.

topics.headline: sound lengthens after rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the warning open into a lighter, drawn-out beat after the compact deterrent.
topics.reason: The sound observation stays close to the local surface and functions as a candidate texture, not as a replacement for the grammatical future scope.

words.gloss_range: you will know; objectless future knowing that functions as warning rather than ordinary information transfer
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, and the sign or mark by which something becomes known; local grammar selects knowing while allowing recognition pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: future particle governing the imperfect verb
qiraat contrast changing the person marker while preserving the plural knowing verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿlamūna}}) closes the ayah with the verb of knowing, but withholds the object that would say what is known. That absence matters because the root is commonly object-taking; here the listener is left at the edge of an unnamed field of recognition rather than a specified fact. The second-person plural form keeps the same addressed group under pressure from 102:2, moving them from people who reached the graves to people who will be made to know. The variant {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) shows that person marking is a live rhetorical pressure, but the base reading remains direct address. The root family supports knowledge as certainty and recognition, including the sign or mark by which something becomes known, while the local Form I verb does not turn the clause into teaching or gradual self-learning. The word is future-loaded by {{ar:سَوْفَ}} ({{tr:sawfa}}), forms a recognizable warning pair with the opening deterrent, is repeated verbatim in 102:4 as the same warning escalates, and then is developed into the named knowledge construction of 102:5. Thus the ayah ends not with resolved content but with compressed, future, objectless knowing.

topics.headline: objectless knowing leaves the threat open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat grows because the verb names coming knowledge while refusing to name the object known.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence explicitly mark {{ar:تَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿlamūna}}) as Form I with no direct object, while contextual valency evidence shows objectless use as a marked minority pattern; broader claims about total rupture are narrowed to the local object-gap payoff.

topics.headline: second-person plural keeps confrontation direct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same plural audience carried across the boundary and confronted directly by the coming knowledge.
topics.reason: The local verb is second masculine plural by form and has an implicit subject; the qiraat contrast with {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) is kept as apparatus showing the force of direct address, not as the governing local parse.

topics.headline: imperfect verb is pushed into certain future
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowing is not described as present insight but as an unavoidable future arrival after the completed prior action.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence forces {{ar:سَوْفَ}} ({{tr:sawfa}}) as the future particle governing this imperfect verb, and the boundary rows validly contrast that projected knowing with the prior completed visit.

topics.headline: root pressure becomes unmistakable recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the coming knowledge as forced recognition after heedlessness, not as casual acquisition of information.
topics.reason: V4 supports the root's knowing branch and sign or mark associations, but the local Form I verb selects knowing; the sign-family pressure is retained as recognition becoming unmistakable, not as an independent local sense.

topics.headline: Form I presents being made to know
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause does not picture a teacher or self-directed learners; the addressees are overtaken by future knowing.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the local verb as Form I, so causative teaching or gradual self-learning forms may clarify contrast but do not control the local clause.

topics.headline: knowing recurs, then becomes named certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local thread: the same knowing verb is repeated at 102:4 and then reworked into named certain knowledge at 102:5.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah references at 102:4 and 102:5, and the root and surface recurrence are not contradicted by the reference evidence.

topics.headline: three-word clause compresses the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's whole warning carried by a minimal sequence of deterrence, future marker, and verb.
topics.reason: The local clause contains the three-word sequence described by the CRITICAL row, and attachment evidence treats them together as the verbal assertion.

topics.headline: place gives way to objectless cognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the boundary move from a concrete graveyard endpoint to abstract, unspecified knowing.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows compare 102:2 with 102:3; attachment support warns against supplying an object for {{ar:تَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿlamūna}}), preserving the boundary movement into open knowing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus clause places second-person plural ع ل م after the interruption كَلَّا and the futurity marker سَوْفَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interruption rejects an unnamed present stance, while futurity suspends but guarantees the opposite condition: a matter now resisted or obscure will become clear to the addressed group.

activation_trace.role: The image of a thing becoming clear to a knower supplies the core disclosure event promised after the sharp interruption.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified announcement that the addressees will acquire information later.
changed_reading.after: A rebuff followed by delayed but unavoidable disclosure: what the group cannot or will not register now is approaching clarity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ع ل م verb can be activated through the focus inventory's branch of a distinguishing mark that guides toward its referent.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing is modeled not only as an inward mental state but as successful orientation by a mark. سَوْفَ then predicts a future condition in which indicators become discriminable enough to guide recognition.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing-and-guiding mark makes future knowing a process of reading signs and locating what they indicate.

changed_reading.before: Future knowledge is treated as a proposition entering the mind.
changed_reading.after: Future knowledge can be recognition through newly legible marks: the addressees will be unable to miss what the signs point toward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Diversion installs a rival object of attention, and competitive increase continually replenishes it. The promised knowing therefore becomes the breaking of an attentional screen rather than the mere delivery of absent data.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the state reached when the screened matter finally becomes clear.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies the attentional displacement that presently blocks disclosure.
Rivalry by number supplies a self-renewing comparison mechanism that keeps attention attached to the substitute object.

structural_cues: 102:1 precedes the focus and addresses the same plural group with a causative distraction.
The distractor is reciprocal competitive increase rather than a single static possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, numerical rivalry, and later disclosure; I supply the arrow that repeated comparison screens a matter already available until كَلَّا breaks the screen. A live alternative is that 102:1 names only the cause of chronological delay, not the internal mechanism of knowing.

changed_reading.before: The group will simply receive knowledge at a later time.
changed_reading.after: The group will be forcibly reoriented toward what competitive comparison has kept outside attention; knowing is the collapse of distraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enjoyable play and rivalry by number form a social contest with a provisional metric of success. Future disclosure acts as a verdict that reverses that metric, so the apparent winners of increase become those whose mismeasurement is exposed.

activation_trace.role: Clarity functions as the adjudicating result that exposes what the contestants' present metric concealed.
Play and enjoyed diversion supply the contest's immediate reward and explain why its metric feels sufficient before the verdict.
Competing for numerical superiority supplies the social relation whose apparent outcome future knowing overturns.

structural_cues: The causative distraction and reciprocal contest in 102:1 share the plural addressees of 102:3.
The abrupt كَلَّا in the focus interrupts the contest before announcing knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies game-like enjoyment, numerical rivalry, and an abrupt future disclosure; I infer a verdict relation in which disclosure judges the rival metric. The live alternative is an affective reading in which play merely distracts, without any winner-loser reversal.

changed_reading.before: You will later understand that the present activity was distracting.
changed_reading.after: You will learn the result of a contest whose scoring system is itself condemned; the future knowledge is a reversal of apparent numerical victory.

context_deltas.mechanism: A purposive arrival at a place characterized by burial, hiddenness, and lowering produces an inversion: passage into the strongest material image of concealment becomes the threshold at which concealment can no longer protect the addressees from disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The becoming-clear image supplies the upward epistemic reversal of what burial places out of view.
Visiting with directed intent supplies the transition and arrival that turns سَوْفَ from vague futurity into an approached threshold.
Hiddenness and downward settling supply the concealment whose reversal gives the promised disclosure its spatial force.

structural_cues: 102:2 places حَتَّىٰ before the visit, presenting it as a reached limit immediately before the focus.
The verb of visiting and the graves occur in one compact motion-to-place construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a limit, purposive arrival, and hidden lowering; I supply the inverse arrow that entry into concealment triggers disclosure. A live alternative is purely chronological: the visit only dates the future knowing and does not causally reverse concealment.

changed_reading.before: Soon marks an unspecified later moment when information arrives.
changed_reading.after: Soon points toward a terminal crossing: arrival at the concealed, lowered place becomes the point where what was hidden is forced into clarity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearly exact return of the focus clause after ثُمَّ converts one warning into an iterable disclosure. The first knowing can be an initial breach of ignorance and the second a later or deeper registration of the same matter.

activation_trace.role: The first becoming-clear event establishes the initial promised disclosure.
The repeated becoming-clear event after ثُمَّ supplies either a second stage of realization or intensified confirmation of the first.

structural_cues: 102:4 repeats كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ with only ثُمَّ added before it.
Both clauses retain the same second-person plural future orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition plus a sequential particle; I infer that disclosure may occur in stages rather than as one instantaneous fact. The materially live alternative is rhetorical doubling that intensifies one event without positing two epistemic moments.

changed_reading.before: A single future instant replaces ignorance with knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Knowing arrives with recurrence: an initial recognition is followed by another disclosure or a deeper, inescapable registration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later conditional combines a doubled knowledge expression with certainty as stable knowledge after doubt. This grades the focus promise: future knowing is not praised as timely insight but appears as the compelled, late substitute for certainty that could govern the present.

activation_trace.role: Future becoming-clear supplies the inevitable knowledge whose timing is placed under scrutiny.
The verb-and-cognate-noun doubling thickens ordinary disclosure into an explicit mode or quality of knowing.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the unrealized present standard against which the promised later knowing is judged.

structural_cues: 102:5 follows the two سَوْفَ clauses but shifts to the conditional particle لَوْ.
The same root appears as both verb and cognate noun before certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future knowing, a later conditional, cognate doubling, and doubt-free stability; I infer a contrast between missed present certainty and unavoidable later recognition. A live alternative is that 102:5 only intensifies the same future knowledge without criticizing its lateness.

changed_reading.before: Future knowledge is intrinsically corrective because it ends ignorance.
changed_reading.after: The threat includes epistemic lateness: the addressees will know inevitably because they do not now live by the stable certainty that could have changed their course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated future seeing gives the promised knowing a sensorium, the fiercely burning object gives it an encounter, and eye-certainty removes distance and doubt. Knowledge becomes compelled witness rather than detachable cognition.

activation_trace.role: Becoming clear supplies the epistemic event that the later visual sequence renders bodily immediate.

summary.what_was_special: The focus root sustained two productive baselines—disclosure and orientation by a mark—while ordered context activated attentional, competitive, spatial, iterative, epistemic-grade, sensory, semiotic, and forensic mechanisms without collapsing them. Rare focus branches and both non-dominant split-root inventories also produced contained material and testimonial readings that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated warning may mark two stages of disclosure or may be rhetorical intensification of one event.
The later seeing may specify the promised knowing's modality, or it may remain a distinct consequence that follows prior knowledge.
The hydraulic, fissure, and extracted-narration readings depend on branch-distant analogies and should remain exploratory even though their packet anchoring is explicit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge as interruption of diversion.** Branch evidence: ع ل م B001, knowing as a thing becomes clear; ل ه و B001, diversion; ي ق ن B001, settled knowledge with doubt removed. Structural cue: "كلا" breaks the previous motion; "سوف" projects a coming event of knowing. Assigned role: علم reverses لهو by bringing the avoided concern into clarity. Abductive move: I infer that the future knowledge concerns what التكاثر had displaced, because the warning follows immediately after the grave-limit. Reading change: the ayah reads as an interruption mechanism: clarity will arrive where distraction had operated.

2. **The warning as a road-marker.** Branch evidence: ع ل م B002, distinguishing mark, landmark, road/boundary marker; ق ب ر B001/B002, grave and hiddenness; ر ء ي B011, flag or marker set up to be seen. Structural cue: this short ayah stands after the cemetery and before the repeated warning. Assigned role: علم B002 turns "you will know" into a marker planted on the route from graves to sight. Abductive move: I infer that the repeated warning functions as a visible boundary sign in the sequence, not only as information. Reading change: the ayah reads as a signpost placed at the cemetery edge.

3. **Future knowledge as forced notification.** Branch evidence: ع ل م B001 includes informing; ر ء ي B012, causing someone to see; س ء ل B001, questioning. Structural cue: the surah later moves from knowing to seeing to being asked. Assigned role: علم is the first stage of compulsory disclosure; رأي and سأل intensify the same procedure. Abductive move: I infer a procedural sequence: notification precedes presentation of evidence and then interrogation. Reading change: "you will know" reads as the opening of an evidentiary process.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 102:5 and 102:7 made this first "سوف تعلمون" less generic. The packet later distinguishes علم اليقين from عين اليقين, so 102:3 now reads as the first procedural notice in a series: warning-knowledge before counterfactual certainty before sight. 102:8 added a legal/audit surprise: the knowledge is not merely existential awareness of death or fire, but preparation for being questioned about a concrete field of نعيم.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The first threshold in a staged disclosure.** Fixed `تَعْلَمُونَ` anchors `ع ل م B001` (a thing becoming clear to the knower). Its structural cue is the exact recurrence in 102:4 after `ثُمَّ`, followed by the verb–noun doubling `تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ` in 102:5 and then two acts of seeing in 102:6–7. The first future knowing is assigned the role of initial cognitive breach in the preceding distraction. I infer that repetition plus sequencing marks distinct or deepening encounters rather than stylistic redundancy. The ayah therefore reads as the first promised stage of unavoidable clarification, not as the whole epistemic event.

2. **Knowledge as a boundary marker on a misdirected route.** Fixed `ع ل م B002` supplies the dormant image of a distinguishing sign or landmark that guides toward something. Structurally, the utterance follows the grave-visit and precedes certainty and direct sight; the repeated formula itself stands like a marker placed twice at the transition. Its assigned role is orientational: it distinguishes the competitive course before the graves from what becomes manifest after them. I supply the analogy between textual repetition and a route marker, and I infer that the grave boundary makes the course newly legible. `تَعْلَمُونَ` thus gains a spatial force: the audience will not only possess information but will encounter the sign that tells them where their course has arrived.

3. **Advance notice that becomes evidence for accountability.** Fixed `ع ل م B001` also includes informing and teaching. The whole-window structure opens with `ر ح م B001` (beneficent mercy), repeats the notification, and closes with passive questioning (`س ء ل B001`) about bestowed well-being (`ن ع م B001`). Informing is assigned the role of notice given before the later interrogation. The packet supplies mercy, repeated warning, and questioning; I infer both that warning is merciful because it precedes compulsion and that repeated notice removes an ignorance defense. The future verb consequently reads in two registers at once: a threat of eventual knowing and a present act of being informed in preparation for answerability.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 102:4's exact repetition after `ثُمَّ` made this fixed occurrence newly visible as a first stage rather than a complete disclosure. Then 102:7's direct eye-certainty supplied the far end of that staged process, and 102:8's questioning retrospectively changed `ع ل م B001` “informing” into advance notice with an evidentiary role in accountability.

Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça üst dudaktaki yarıkla sınırlar; insanın üst dudağının yarılmış olması, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki aynı belirti ve üst dudağı yarma eylemi bu kimliği doğrular. concept_map.definition: İnsanın üst dudağında veya devenin üst dudak bölgesinde bulunan belirgin yarıktır. Aynı dal, bu özelliği taşıyanı niteleyen biçimi ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Üst dudakta bulunan yarık, dalın anatomik çekirdeğini oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yarığın yerini üst dudak olarak ortak biçimde sınırlar ve yarıklı insanı bu özellikle niteler. Toplu tanıklık, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki karşılığını ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de aynı dalda gösterir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deniz ile suyu bol kuyu tek bir ara nesnede birleştirilmez; bunlar aynı biçimin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı sözlük karşılığıdır.

Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.
